decision_conditions: The existing use of the first, second and third floor of the property known as 40-42 High Street, Sutton as 11 self contained flats are lawful under section 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended), as the applicant has provided satisfactory evidence to demonstrate that the units have been occupied and self contained for at least 4 years prior to the date of the application being submitted.
